losers do not debit sequence or KV capacity
blocked operation has not sampled the authority clock
operation rejects after lock wait crosses its deadline
late lock acquisition leaves no new credit
first dispatcher wins a persistent transition
dispatch ACK loss does not authorize another send
unknown dispatch is not released by TTL
worker launches the fixed tuple once
publication retry returns the same durable revision
promotion leaves running work pinned to the former bundle
stale route cannot mint a new hold
a live old stream prevents unloading
rollback cannot route to a draining old worker
rollback cannot switch persisted-state schema
retirement retains capacity until physical evidence
old generation cannot release the current permit
